relationships.publicationTitle: Casgliad o Hymnau, Caniadau, ac Odlau Ysbrydol, at Wasanaeth Saint y Dyddiau Diweddaf, yn Nghymru
relationships.researchNote: Possible D.R. connection. Ronald D. Dennis identified a wording match between this D.R.-credited hymn and a hymn preserved in Roberts family material.
relationships.evidenceNote: The printed source supplies the initials D.R.; the wording match is a researcher identification and does not by itself establish authorship.
